summary_en: This study tests Novilase laser therapy, a device that destroys breast tumors using image-guided laser, in women with breast cancer tumors 15 mm or smaller. Each participant receives image-guided laser ablation of the targeted tumor through the skin, then an MRI and excision 4 to 6 weeks later. The main outcome is the rate of complete ablation, judged by pathology and MRI, compared with a performance goal of 80% based on lumpectomy.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa la terapia con láser Novilase, un dispositivo que destruye tumores de mama mediante láser guiado por imagen, en mujeres con tumores de cáncer de mama de 15 mm o menos. Cada participante recibe ablación con láser guiada por imagen del tumor objetivo, a través de la piel, y luego una resonancia magnética y una escisión a las 4 a 6 semanas. El resultado principal es la tasa de ablación completa, evaluada por patología y resonancia magnética, comparada con una meta de desempeño del 80 % basada en la lumpectomía.
who_for: Women aged 18 or older who can give written informed consent.
Single (unifocal) breast tumor no longer than 15 mm, confirmed by needle core biopsy.
Tumor clearly visible on ultrasound or mammography and on MRI.
Weight 300 lbs (136 kg) or less, with no significant comorbidities affecting life expectancy.
Agrees to follow standard radiation or adjuvant therapy as prescribed.
not_for: Contraindications to gadolinium contrast or MRI, or severe kidney disease.
Advanced stage breast cancer, or lobular, sarcoma, phyllodes, Paget's, or metastatic tumor.
Known BRCA positive, or triple-negative tumor (ER, PR and HER2 negative).
More than 25% intraductal component on core biopsy, or only DCIS with microinvasion.
